# Bulk SiO2 calculation

units real
atom_style full
boundary p p p

read_data sio2.data
replicate 2 2 2

pair_style reaxff NULL
pair_coeff * * /potentials/REAXFF/ffield.reax Si O

fix QEQ all qeq/reaxff 1 0.0 10.0 1.0e-6 reaxff

minimize ${etol} ${ftol} ${maxiter} ${maxeval}

variable ebulk equal pe
variable natoms equal count(all)
variable ebulk_per_atom equal v_ebulk/v_natoms

print "Bulk energy per atom = ${ebulk_per_atom}" file bulk_energy.txt

# Surface SiO2 calculation

units real
atom_style full
boundary p p f

read_data sio2.data
replicate 2 2 2

pair_style reaxff NULL
pair_coeff * * /potentials/REAXFF/ffield.reax Si O

fix QEQ all qeq/reaxff 1 0.0 10.0 1.0e-6 reaxff

minimize ${etol} ${ftol} ${maxiter} ${maxeval}

variable esurf equal pe
variable natoms equal count(all)
variable esurf_per_atom equal v_esurf/v_natoms

# Get box dimensions
variable xlen equal lx
variable ylen equal ly

# Calculate surface area (2 surfaces created)
variable area equal 2*v_xlen*v_ylen

print "Surface energy per atom = ${esurf_per_atom}" file surface_energy.txt
print "Surface area = ${area}" append surface_energy.txt

# Set minimization parameters
variable etol equal 1.0e-10
variable ftol equal 1.0e-10
variable maxiter equal 100000
variable maxeval equal 100000

# Run bulk calculation
include bulk.in
clear

# Run surface calculation
include surface.in

# Define simulation box
boundary p p p
read_data Al.data

# Replicate the system 5x5x5
replicate 5 5 5

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Store final energy
variable E equal pe
run 0
print "${E}" file bulk_energy.txt

# Surface Al calculation
units metal
atom_style atomic

# Define simulation box
boundary p p f
read_data Al.data

# Replicate the system 5x5x5
replicate 5 5 5

# Add vacuum in z direction
change_box all z scale 2.0

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Store final energy
variable E equal pe
run 0
print "${E}" file surface_energy.txt
